# Gobiya — SEO & Web Development Agency, Los Angeles
> https://www.gobiya.com

Gobiya is a digital marketing and SEO agency in Los Angeles, California. Steve Martin started the practice in 2010 and incorporated it as Gobiya LLC in 2012. The agency specializes in technical SEO, Google algorithm recovery, local SEO, custom React and Next.js web development, Google Ads management, and content written to appear in AI-generated answers. Steve Martin runs the agency directly — he is bilingual (English and Spanish) and has 25+ years of experience in SEO, web development, and digital marketing. Gobiya is BBB A+ rated and serves clients in home services, dental, real estate, SaaS, e-commerce, and professional services across Los Angeles and the U.S.

## What Gobiya does

**SEO and algorithm recovery** — Diagnosing why a site lost rankings after a Google core update, manual penalty, or technical regression, then fixing the specific cause. Gobiya has tracked every major Google algorithm change since Panda (2011) inside active client accounts.

**Technical SEO** — Crawl audits, Core Web Vitals, structured data (JSON-LD schema markup), internal link architecture, indexability, and duplicate content resolution.

**Local SEO** — Google Business Profile optimization, NAP citation cleanup, map-pack rankings, and location page content for businesses in Los Angeles, Burbank, Glendale, Beverly Hills, and surrounding markets.

**Google Ads and paid media** — Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta Ads, and Yelp Ads management. Managed budgets up to $15,000/month. Documented results include 5.7x return on ad spend for a windows and doors company and 4.2x ROAS for a home remodeling company.

**Web development** — Custom React, Vite, and Next.js websites built without templates or page builders. Every build targets sub-second load times and a 90+ Lighthouse performance score.

**SEO copywriting and GEO** — Content structured to rank in Google and be cited by AI models including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

## Documented results

- SmileCenter Dentistry: 5x increase in patient inquiry volume. Custom React rebuild, local SEO, schema markup, and location-specific content architecture. 213,000 monthly search impressions.
- American Livescan: 3x increase in online bookings after site migration and local citation cleanup.
- Simply Home Remodeling: 45% organic traffic increase, 12 service pages ranked on Google page one, form-fill rate improved from 2.3% to 7.8%, Google Ads CPC reduced 35%.
- All City Windows & Doors: 47 commercial keywords ranked, 5.7x Google Ads ROAS on $15K/month budget, cost per lead reduced 40%, appointments doubled within 30 days of site redesign.
- E&E Home Remodeling: 200+ qualified leads per month, 4.2x ROAS across Google, Bing, and Facebook Ads, email engagement increased 62%.
- B2B SaaS client: 61% reduction in cost per lead after Google Ads rebuild.
- DG Plumbing & Rooter: 40% organic traffic growth after site redesign.

## Clients served

SmileCenter Dentistry, American Livescan, Simply Home Remodeling, E&E Home Remodeling, All City Windows & Doors, Remodel Me Pros, Mr. Speedy Plumbing & Rooter, SafetyCentric, QuickPass AiD, The ARK Crypto, Sonrisa Dental & Ortho, Lumina Gastro, My Trust Wills, Total Capital Inc., DG Plumbing & Rooter, Tidder.

## Steve Martin — founder

Steve Martin founded Gobiya in 2010 after 10 years in web development and internet marketing. He built a video distribution platform for Sony Music artists at Webcastr.com (2000–2005) and provided web technology support at AT&T WorldNet (1996–2000). He holds a Certificate in Website Design from Glendale Career College (1996) and was a certified Google Partner for Google Ads and Analytics from 2015 to 2019. He is bilingual in English and Spanish.
